# PdfRenderResult

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the results of the PDF rendering phase (Phase 1). This data structure holds all the calculated content streams, font mappings, image resources, and hyperlinks needed to write the PDF file.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`OrientedPageSize`](#orientedpagesize): The oriented page size from document settings
- [`PageContentStreams`](#pagecontentstreams): The rendered content streams for each page
- [`PageDimensions`](#pagedimensions): Maps page indices to their dimensions (width, height, margin)
- [`RenderContext`](#rendercontext): The render context containing font mappings, image mappings, and hyperlinks
